author: reek
body: Database schema for the explorer app. Defines tables using the Codex data quire, seeds them from ExplorerData defaults. The server CDX boots with a RuntimeDb, creates these tables if they don't exist, and populates from the compiled defaults.

author: reek
body: Runtime changes (user prefs, generation history) are persisted to the IDE disk image. The .codex defaults are the seed -- the DB on disk is the live state.
